ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels localized on the outer lobes to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated at the trailing edges and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions occupy the outer lateral areas of both lobes. A primary dark pigment block is centered at the median notch, extending as a border along the trailing edge. Small, discrete circular dark spots are mapped specifically on the white surface of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by sharp peaks and deep asymmetric valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a convex curve from the median notch, rising sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel groupings (barnacles) are clearly visible at the extreme left and right distal tips of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible crossing the white pigmentation field on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and deep indentations along the trailing edge indicative of significant physical trauma or wear; extensive barnacle colonization on both lobe terminals.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique constellation of approximately four to five distinct dark circular spots localized in the upper-mid white field of the right lobe.
